patch_description:
Replace uniform partner selection with one local ranking rule: prefer eligible cohort members already connected on the opposite layer, then maximize common within-cohort neighbors on the addition layer, reservoir-sampling ties. If no eligible overlap partner exists, preserve the original uniform selection and random-draw order. Count common neighbors only through permitted same-layer neighbor queries.
This may accelerate overlap and triangle formation before the unchanged time-93 recovery handoff. Acceptance, failure memory, cohort targets and pruning remain unchanged, including consent to finite negative-gain cohort offers. The risk is concentrating construction around existing clusters while delaying other links. This is an untested hypothesis; support requires improved full-panel terminal utility, assessed across the 36 history families with actor-level losses retained.
